blocks.text: Filipino-owned construction materials company Buildrite Construction Chemicals is advocating greater use of homegrown technologies and stronger local expertise to help develop future-ready cities and world-class infrastructure in the Philippines. At the recent BUILDRITE S.T.R.O.N.G. BUILDERS SUMMIT 2026, Derrick A. Tan, founder, president and chief executive officer of Buildrite Construction Chemicals, called on architects, engineers, contractors and government agencies to strengthen the country’s capabilities in construction technology and materials engineering. Tan emphasized the need to move beyond looking to other countries as models for infrastructure development and instead cultivate Filipino innovation, technical knowledge and engineering expertise to create structures that reflect the […]...
